First, 13 weeks + 7 days = 13×7 + 7 = 91 + 7 = 98 days.  
Subtract 98 days from 1588-05-13.  
1588 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not by 100 unless by 400, but 1588 is before Gregorian reform? Actually 1582 reform, but for arithmetic we treat proleptic Gregorian: yes, leap year).  
May 13 → back 13 days → April 30 → back 30 more days → March 31 → back remaining 55 days: March has 31 days, so 55-31=24 days left → back to February 29 (leap year) → 24 days before Feb 29 is Feb 5.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1588-02-05
